scope.adjudication_unit: One row per baseline failure check, keyed physical leg_id#criterion; 93 checks consolidate to 60 physical legs.

baseline_qbi_scope_evidence.extraction: Decoded exact tag-7 UTF-8 support channels; scoped person_support_clone_index==1; mapped person households to w00000; recomputed weighted incidence and qbi_inputs.py identity equations at 1e-8.

definitions.ratio: [sum ACS weight on nonzero/sign leg / sum ACS origin-scope weight] / [sum ASEC weight on nonzero/sign leg / sum ASEC origin-scope weight]
definitions.best_arm_method: minimum multiplicative log-distance to incidence band, normalized QED exceedance, or dead-status indicator; exact ties retained
definitions.best_arm_tie_auxiliary: When tied criterion winners disagree on a non-ranking auxiliary field, candidate_ratio_band_status is mixed_by_arm and auxiliary_by_arm preserves each result.
definitions.quantile_envelope_zero_denominator: A quantile pair with |q_ASEC|+|q_ACS| equal to zero contributes distance zero.

minimal_green_set.statement: Every one of the current 93 checks/60 red physical legs must stop emitting failures; the battery uses passed=not failures and pool readiness conjuncts its two uniquely named terminal gates, so no smaller current-red check subset can green it.

full_battery_rerun_required.reason: Clearing all current reds is necessary but not sufficient: remedies can create new failures, as the eligibility and investment arms demonstrate. Certification requires a full rerun with no new red legs.

minimal_green_set.work_package_interpretation: The ten work packages are a non-overlapping coverage partition of current reds, not a proven minimal implementation set or ten independent one-change fixes.
minimal_green_set.scope_fix_requirement: The two dead SSTB checks require a terminal role-scope fix, not an exclusion: compare their declared PUF-owned signal on clone 1 and continuously enforce the coupled QBI identities.

summary.top_five_interpretation: Coverage-ranked workstreams, not five proven single fixes; each can require target-specific subfixes after receipt or data inspection. The future retirement bundle factorial is a separate landing guardrail and clears no baseline red.

rejected_measurement_mismatch_claims.required_fix: Add per-target clone-role ownership to the canonical metric authority, assign the two SSTB flags to clone 1, and terminally enforce their clone-1 by-origin comparisons plus coupled QBI identities.

reviewed_exclusion_support.why_no_sparse_candidates: All 48 red QEDs have minima of 48 ASEC carriers and 519 ACS carriers, above the five-carrier skip. Keogh is one-sided at 2 ASEC carrier rows and 0 ACS carrier rows, so QED is skipped after incidence still fails; it is policy-relevant and remains a real blocker.
reviewed_exclusion_support.structural_absence_distinction: US declared structural-absence rules remove only authority-bound rows after an exact equation check; a mismatch emits a failure. They are not reviewed defect exceptions.
reviewed_exclusion_support.uk_precedent_attestation_limitation: The UK loader and gates validate and evaluate all five schema-2 receipt fields, but binding evidence is not uniform: degenerate exposes full resolved records, input mass hashes only its reference, and QRF tail has no evidence hook. Any future US machinery should seal full resolved receipts.
